claim_text: Fields of people throughout the United States filled with and controlled by the Holy Ghost, with a mighty rushing wind and cloven tongues of fire, something never seen before that touches the nations in a Holy Ghost Woodstock.
quote: a mighty, mighty Holy Ghost Woodstock
falsify_match: Open-air religious gatherings on that scale across America.
falsify_miss: None. Fields of people would be visible and countable if it happened.

claim_text: In the meeting with the Israeli prime minister they have wisdom, and out of it comes a Jonathan and David relationship like never before with a flow to it, alongside divine friendships and financial blessing over America like a mighty waterfall.
quote: there is a Jonathan David relationship coming up out of this
falsify_match: A close and durable alliance between the two leaders.
falsify_miss: A break between them. Financial blessing like a waterfall is not defined against anything.

claim_text: Thanking God for exposing the rat in the White House and the terror cells in America, praying an outpouring over Cuba and Europe, and taking authority over the virus and all the plans to release it, binding it back so that it will not happen.
quote: All the plans they have to try to do this virus
falsify_match: No engineered outbreak.
falsify_miss: One occurs. He declares it will not happen, against his own repeated word that it will.

claim_text: They are summoning old demonic spirits and trying to rebirth the Hitler spirit that was on the nations and brought the second world war, through human sacrifice and satanic practice with old spells and ancient tablets in Europe.
quote: rebirth the Hitler spirit that was on the nations
falsify_match: Nothing observable unless such a ritual were exposed.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. He offers the word conjuring as his own description.

claim_text: He recalls seeing dark men and women trying to distract from the file list, and reads an email saying the list was hacked because the attorney general leaked the passcodes to the estate's accounts by accident, letting somebody in to three million items including unredacted material.
quote: Pam Bundy leaked the codes on accident
falsify_match: Confirmation that the passcodes were leaked by that official.
falsify_miss: The account is wrong. He is relaying a viewer email and says supposedly.

claim_text: He asks whether this is the greater embarrassing moments concerning politicians he said would come out, things not blacked out, with a ransom of over forty million dollars, and says the Lord told him the three million emails leaked are just the beginning.
quote: The three million emails that were leaked is just the beginning
falsify_match: Further and larger disclosures from the same material.
falsify_miss: None follow. Just the beginning is the part that can be scored.

claim_text: The glory of the Lord in the auditoriums and theatres in Branson, starting to manifest at a named prayer mountain and growing out of there until they cannot hold the services and it moves into the theatres.
quote: Even in the auditoriums in Branson, Missouri, in the theaters
falsify_match: Meetings outgrowing that site and moving into Branson theatres.
falsify_miss: They do not. This precedes his own plan to buy a theatre there by eight weeks.

claim_text: The rapture of the church comes out of it, and it will be like the children of Israel whose garments and shoes did not wear out and who had no feeble one among them, all healed and whole walking out of Egypt, as a sign and wonder done to the bride without spot or wrinkle.
quote: then the rapture of the church comes out of it
falsify_match: Mass healing preceding a disappearance.
falsify_miss: Neither. The healing claim is the part that could be observed before the rapture.

claim_text: Signs following those who believe from Europe, Africa, South America, Asia and Australia, and a major move of God in Canada starting even this year, matching what another man saw in the sky, a great wake-up call with fearful sights.
quote: a major move of God starting even this year
falsify_match: A visible religious movement in Canada during 2026.
falsify_miss: None. Starting even this year dates it, which is unusual for the revival material.

claim_text: The revival starts with the youth, because the devil came after them hard and he is coming after them harder, with a major revival through the youth and the colleges and the greatest harvest this generation has seen, and Iran shaken in the midnight hour with the Ayatollah removed.
quote: the devil came after the youth hard, but I'm coming after them harder
falsify_match: A measurable religious movement on American campuses.
falsify_miss: None. Campus revivals have been reported episodically, which is the base rate to exceed.

claim_text: He says the Lord is liberating the people of Iran right now as they speak, from the Ayatollah and from the tyrant government, with a major revival breaking forth in Iran right now and people weeping in the streets because they have just been liberated.
quote: a major revival is going to break forth in Iran right now
falsify_match: Iranians celebrating a liberation in the streets in February 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind. He puts it in the present tense here, which makes it dateable.

claim_text: It is around the Olympics, the Antichrist agenda with CERN, and the Vatican and all of Europe summoning the Hitler spirit again, calling for greater war and for the Mahdi.
quote: I see the Vatican all of Europe summoning that Hitler spirit again
falsify_match: Nothing observable from the summoning itself.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. The Olympics give it a date but not a testable event.

claim_text: If he can discourage the praying believers and stop the church preaching truth, righteousness, repentance and holiness, then as America goes so goes the world in prayer and fasting, but they will raise the standard and have a revival and a last outpouring.
quote: as America goes, so does the world in prayer
falsify_match: A visible last outpouring.
falsify_miss: None. Conditioning it on the church means an absence is their failure.

claim_text: They have not prayed enough, which is why the Lord said to pray for him, that no weapon and no bullet comes near him and they do not take his life, because he sees a plan and a conspiracy to remove this man by Macron and the elitists in Europe since he is coming against the UN.
quote: A plot of trying to remove this man
falsify_match: A plot against the president traced to European figures.
falsify_miss: None. The prayer condition means an absence is read as the answer.

claim_text: It was God who liberated those people rather than the military or the equipment, so that they could worship freely without persecution, and now he asks God to do it again with Iran, Cuba and North Korea and shake the nations for a move of God around the world as a witness, after which the end will come.
quote: Do it again with Iran. And do it again with Cuba
falsify_match: Religious liberty established in all three.
falsify_miss: None. Three regime changes are asked for together, which raises the bar.

claim_text: A drone falls and they are protected with no men or women hurt, but he does not believe it is a one and done, having seen another boat out in the water hit on its side, and there are other things about the Iran escalation he cannot reveal publicly to protect the people involved.
quote: I saw that other boat out in the water be hit on the side
falsify_match: An American vessel struck on its side.
falsify_miss: None struck. He withholds the rest for operational reasons, which removes the detail.

claim_text: The old alliances from the 1960s Cuban missile crisis being rekindled with Russia flying in, biological things being stored on the island of Cuba, but the Cubans will be liberated soon and their government will fall, which he ties to reports that they have only a couple of weeks of money and oil left.
quote: I saw uh biological things being stored in Cuba's island
falsify_match: Biological material found in Cuba, and a change of government.
falsify_miss: Neither. This is the earliest telling of the material stored on the island.

claim_text: Cuba says it wants a meeting, but he warned they would try to attack in the secret of the night while Russia flies in planes, and says that from about the third going into the Olympics in three days is the two week window in which the Lord said there would be great trouble.
quote: Watch them in the secret of the night that they would try to attack
falsify_match: A Cuban night attack inside that fortnight.
falsify_miss: Nothing in that window, which closed in mid February 2026 and can be scored.

claim_text: He says they are not going to have a red wave and it is already happening, pointing to a result in Fort Worth in the Bible belt that has not gone that way in thirty years, and warns of what they will see eight or nine months from now if they do not start praying.
quote: We're not going to have no red wave. It's already happening
falsify_match: Democratic gains at the November 2026 midterms.
falsify_miss: A Republican wave. This sits directly against his own biggest red wave word.

claim_text: In Cuba in the middle of the night, planes coming in from China delivering weapons never seen before, laser weapons and things that would be bad, alongside California and the corruption there, with prayer for a young investigator and a named broadcaster and for corruption uncovered in California, Seattle and Portland.
quote: the planes coming in from China delivering those weapons
falsify_match: Chinese weapon deliveries to Cuba by air.
falsify_miss: None. Here the destination is Cuba, where the same image elsewhere goes to Iran.

claim_text: Praying to expose the darkness as with the laboratory found that day in California with biological weapons in it, and another one, that all of it is brought to justice and nobody is hurt.
quote: found out about that lab with all the biological weapons
falsify_match: Nothing of his own. He is praying over a news report.
falsify_miss: Nothing of his own is claimed here.

claim_text: Snow in Japan, which his son puts at two hundred feet or twenty feet, before turning to the Musk material.
quote: Like 200 feet of snow or something like that
falsify_match: Record snowfall in Japan.
falsify_miss: Ordinary snowfall. The figure is corrected downward by a factor of ten within the sentence.

claim_text: The Lord said the named businessman would be heavily persecuted in Europe with much coming against his platform and the funding drying up, and out of it a new Watergate scandal from blackmail concerning him, the United States government, the vice president and political figures, with censorship rising in Europe and trickling into America through the social platforms.
quote: I saw a new Watergate scandal coming out of blackmail
falsify_match: A blackmail scandal of that scale involving those figures.
falsify_miss: None. He names the vice president, which is the checkable part.

claim_text: His office complex and platform facility were raided in Europe that day with computers taken, which he ties to the major lawsuits he saw coming concerning Germany, Italy, France, England and Finland and a crackdown on the platform.
quote: major lawsuits concerning Germany, Italy, France and England
falsify_match: Legal action against the platform in those five countries.
falsify_miss: None in most of them. Naming five jurisdictions makes a partial hit likely somewhere.

claim_text: A great deal is happening in Europe, and he says he does not know about the sexual content on the platform and if it is perverted then the action against it is rightful, but all he saw was that it would affect the money.
quote: All I saw that it would affect the money
falsify_match: Revenue or funding losses at the platform.
falsify_miss: None. He concedes the action may be deserved, which is unusually fair-minded for this material.

claim_text: He is not justifying it and says good for them for busting him if it concerns the AI assistant, but that it is still something coming against him, and it will keep getting worse until England, Italy and Germany and all Europe come against it.
quote: it will keep getting worse and worse and worse
falsify_match: Escalating European action against the platform.
falsify_miss: It eases. He questions his own use of the word persecution here.

claim_text: He saw it spreading into America and that is where the Watergate scandal comes out of it, so part of the vision is already happening and already starting to manifest, leading to a blackmail scandal against the administration.
quote: So it's part of the vision is already happening
falsify_match: The censorship spreading to America and a blackmail scandal following.
falsify_miss: Neither. Claiming part of it as already fulfilled is what makes the rest harder to score.

claim_text: An Arab nation giving the administration and the sons five hundred million dollars or so for their crypto, which he ties to the Lord saying he would double and triple their wealth.
quote: You were going to double and triple their wealth
falsify_match: A doubling or tripling of that family's wealth.
falsify_miss: It does not. Published wealth estimates would settle this.

claim_text: An afternoon session, and he says the Lord showed a great deal in the last prayer video concerning this war and the military, but that the Lord will not allow him to go into it.
quote: the Lord will not allow me to go
falsify_match: Nothing. He withholds the content.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Another point where the detail stays off the record.

claim_text: He asks whether they have had a regime change in Iran, says he does not add to or take away and there are things he cannot talk about, and asks whether the boats have anti-aircraft systems to shoot the missiles down, so they should pray for them to be on alert.
quote: don't they have anti-aircraft systems to shoot off missiles
falsify_match: American ships struck despite their defences.
falsify_miss: None struck. He asks the question rather than making the claim.

claim_text: First responders coming in with the first firefighter through the door dropping immediately because of an individual in the vision, with hidden things to be discovered concerning the Chicago airport and hotels, which he calls a very prominent and detailed vision though he does not know the time frame, and then the river in New York with a massive building and the forty first floor.
quote: I saw one individual firefighter, the first one in drop immediately
falsify_match: An incident at a Chicago hotel disabling a responder on entry.
falsify_miss: None. A responder collapsing on entry points to a chemical agent rather than a blast.

claim_text: They were going to get information of the file list kind to expose darkness in major arenas and wanted a ransom of over forty million dollars, which he calls big money, but they did not get what they wanted, and he saw something embarrassing.
quote: Over $40 million is what I was shown. Big bucks
falsify_match: A ransom demand of that size over such files.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling, three weeks before he scores it himself as not right.

claim_text: The colours connected to this darkness with key figures from a named basketball team past and present, and musicians living and dead, one of whom he names by nickname because the man is dead, in something going on underground since the foundation of America whose exposure will expose a generation, followed by a new Edward Snowden.
quote: One which I thought maybe I could say their name because he's dead
falsify_match: Named sports and music figures exposed in such a network.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling and it names a dead singer by nickname.

claim_text: It was genetically created in a lab and spread through animals, and he saw rats rather than bats spreading the virus throughout Europe, injected into the rats which were then released into heavily populated areas.
quote: I saw them injecting it with the into the rat
falsify_match: A deliberate rodent-borne release in European cities.
falsify_miss: None. Deliberate release is the specific part, beyond a natural outbreak.

claim_text: People got sick and after they got it they went home and died, that fast, happening in Europe and exploding from there, with the face of each continent turning red and fading out as the virus went through like a film.
quote: after they got it they they just they went home. They died
falsify_match: An epidemic with a near total fatality rate.
falsify_miss: None. No pathogen in history has behaved that way in humans.

claim_text: It went through Africa, down through South America and all of Asia, spreading like ink bleeding across paper, and he says he has seen this vision so many times that it is how he knows it matters.
quote: It was bleeding. It was spreading like a like like you would spread liquid
falsify_match: A global epidemic on that path.
falsify_miss: None. Repetition is his own criterion for significance, which is worth recording.

claim_text: They go into tent cities with cots of sick and dying people, laying hands on them and raising them from their deathbeds, with hospitals full and tents in the parking lots of large grocery stores because there is nowhere to put the bodies, and a massive medical ship with a big cross moored outside New York.
quote: It was a big cross on it and it was a massive medical boat
falsify_match: A hospital ship moored at New York during an epidemic.
falsify_miss: None. That happened once in 2020, which is the precedent the image draws on.

claim_text: As the Egyptians had their trouble while the glory of the Lord was over the children of Israel, they are a representation of the same thing, and the Lord said he will provide for his people and put a protection around them, so they must prepare themselves.
quote: I'm gonna provide for my people. I'm gonna put a protection around
falsify_match: Believers visibly spared in an epidemic.
falsify_miss: They are not. Preparing yourself is the condition attached to the protection.

claim_text: He shows a headline and says this is what they saw, that the purpose was a hedge of protection over Taiwan to give them more time and bring revival through Asia, China and the Koreas, with confusion in the regime of China, because the Lord said a major wave of his presence is coming and there will be a shaking in China starting with the military trying to remove the leader.
quote: it will start with the military and they will try to out uh Ping
falsify_match: A military move against the Chinese leadership.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling of the coup in China.

claim_text: They will try to get him out and bring in a new government because of so much confusion and chaos in the Chinese government, with major financial shakings in China, and he points to a headline saying the leader has lost complete control over the military as the confirmation, two weeks after they began praying it.
quote: There'll be a major financial shakings in China
falsify_match: Confirmed instability in the Chinese leadership.
falsify_miss: None. He treats a headline as the fulfilment two weeks after the word.

claim_text: He plays a senator saying to strangle Iran's economy until it falls and the people take over, with Hezbollah, Hamas and the Houthis all falling and the regime the weakest since 1979, and calls it Reagan, tying it to his own word that he saw a face divided half Trump and half Reagan.
quote: do you remember every time I told you I saw Reagan divided in his face?
falsify_match: The Iranian government falling to internal collapse.
falsify_miss: It holds. He takes a senator's opinion as confirmation of the divided face image.

claim_text: The senator is saying in the natural what he saw in the spirit, and then liberation coming to Cuba with a person who would go in and free the Cuban people to have freedom of religion after living under a dictator, and the same for the North Korean leader whose days are coming to an end.
quote: I saw liberation coming to Cuba
falsify_match: Religious freedom established in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Freedom of religion is the specific outcome named here.

claim_text: The Lord says he is getting rid of the one he calls the Pillsbury doughboy, the North Korean leader and his sister, and the tyrants, with a great revival in North Korea in a small window because the military will try to rein it in, a shaking in China, and a dome of protection prayed over Taiwan because they will try to take the land unless it is held back by prayer.
quote: I'm getting rid of the Pillsbury door boy
falsify_match: The North Korean leader and his sister removed.
falsify_miss: Neither is. The small window and the military reining it in explain a short or invisible revival.

claim_text: The president operates as a type and shadow of Reagan, which is when he was seeing the Cold War and the darkness of Cuba, and the Lord keeps saying to pay attention to Cuba, which was highlighted again and completely dark in the last video, with a choice to make in this valley of decision.
quote: I saw Cuba and it was highlighted again, but it was completely dark
falsify_match: A Cuban blackout or collapse.
falsify_miss: None. Island-wide blackouts had already been happening for over a year when he said this.

claim_text: He will not make America a goat nation and it will remain a sheep nation, with a mighty revival and the sound of a rushing wind from sea to shining sea and from Canada to the Gulf, and the pastors, teachers and evangelists preaching that the Lord is coming sooner than later.
quote: We will remain a sheep nation in the name of Jesus
falsify_match: Nothing measurable. The sheep and goat division is a judgment claim.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable. Stated as a declaration rather than a word.
